name: threejs-collect
description: A 3D collect game in Three.js through make-game, judged on vendored Three.js (offline), the bots winning it in the headless browser, and the gates.

input.brief: A 3D third-person game in Three.js: a fox collects 8 glowing coins around a walled courtyard with platforms, dodges rolling spike balls, and escapes through a door that opens after the last coin.
